summary.description: Concise 1-3 sentence summary of the code review outcome and highest-impact risks.

findings.description: List of concrete code review findings. Empty array if no issues are found.

severity.description: CRITICAL/HIGH block pushes and PR merges; MEDIUM/LOW are non-blocking advisories.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the affected file from the diff.

line.description: 1-based line number in the new version of the file (use 1 if file-level or deleted).

explanation.description: Clear technical explanation of the defect, loophole, or guideline violation and its impact.

suggested_fix.description: Actionable, concrete code or design change to remediate the issue.
